title: Criminal prosecution
text:
20.24.020 Criminal prosecution.
Any person violating any provision of this title shall be guilty of a misdemeanor and upon conviction, be fined a sum not exceeding two thousand dollars. Each day that a provision of this title is violated shall constitute a separate offense.
(Ord. 16653 § 2(part), 2007)
(Ord. No. 17235, § 4, 11-10-2009)
